name: Toy Battle

categories.label: Captured enemy H.Q.
categories.hint: Placing a Troop on the enemy H.Q. wins immediately.

categories.label: Medals collected
categories.hint: Medals taken by controlling regions; kept even if control is lost. Objective number depends on the Terrain.

categories.label: Medals objective reached
categories.hint: Reaching the number of Medals shown on the Terrain's objective wins immediately.

tiebreakers.description: If a player cannot draw or place a Troop, most Medals wins; on a tie, the player who ended the game loses

winCondition: Win immediately by placing a Troop on the enemy H.Q. or by reaching the Medals objective shown on the chosen Terrain. If a player cannot draw or place a Troop, the game ends and the player with more Medals wins; on equal Medals the player who ended the game loses.

endCondition.description: Enemy H.Q. captured, Medals objective reached, or a player cannot draw/place a Troop

notes: family: objective-area-control. Medals objective varies by the 8 Terrains (see board). Some Terrains have multiple H.Q.; capturing one suffices.

sources.title: Toy Battle Rulebook EN (Repos Production)
sources.section: p.5-6 Controlling a region; End of the game
